desc: Implement input reading for T test cases.
For each test case, parse N, A, and B.
Extract positions of 1s in A ($A_{pos}$) and B ($B_{pos}$).
Check if count of 1s in A is less than count of 1s in B; if so, print -1.
Binary search for the minimum distance $D$.
Determine valid intervals for each piece $i$: $[a_i-D, a_i+D]$.
Greedily assign $t_i \in B_{pos}$ such that $t_i \ge t_{i-1}$ and $t_i$ is in the valid interval.
Verify if all elements in $B_{pos}$ are present in the assigned $t$ values.
Ensure efficient I/O and $O(N)$ or $O(N \log N)$ complexity per test case.
